title: Read JSON parameters
summary: Phoenix: Read JSON parameters. Send an empty object.
introduction: Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}. The endpoint parser puts the fields into params.

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Read JSON parameters
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
post "/books", LessonController, :create
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def create(conn, %{"title" => title}) when is_binary(title), do: conn |> put_status(201) |> json(%{title: title})
def create(conn, _params), do: conn |> put_status(400) |> json(%{error: "Title needed"})
end

blocks.text: The title pattern and is_binary guard match. The pipe sets 201 before sending JSON.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Provide a fallback function clause for input that does not match.
